summary: Iteration 3 — E2EE + Live Pings + Landing page full-stack test. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass (13 previous + 8 new for encrypted flag echo on POST /api/upload & GET /api/file/{pin}, SSE /api/pings/{pin} 404 on unknown PIN, 400 on invalid PIN, `ready` + `download` frames with full payload keys (at/kind/filename/size/device/browser/downloads_remaining), zip kind for multi-file, and confirmation that invalid file_id no longer consumes a download slot). Frontend Playwright e2e: landing page renders (hero/nav/CTA all navigate to /app), E2EE toggle row visible on /app, non-E2EE happy path (SHA-256 of downloaded plaintext == uploaded plaintext, share URL without #k=, no e2ee-badge), E2EE happy path (e2ee-badge on sender, #k= in share URL, e2ee-receive-badge on recipient, button reads 'Decrypt & download', decrypted content SHA matches original plaintext — not ciphertext), missing-key case (#k= stripped → missing-key-warning shown & download button disabled), Live Pings (status pill flips to 'Listening' after SSE ready, live-pings-empty visible before download, live-ping-item appears on sender within seconds of a download from another tab, toast 'Someone downloaded · Desktop' visible). No console errors observed. PinResult catch-block fix confirmed by presence of console.error branch in code; download events still process correctly (no regression).

minor.issue: Still uses asyncio.create_task from sync BackgroundTask (carried over from prior iterations); works but fragile.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') deprecated in FastAPI — should migrate to lifespan context manager.
In-memory _ping_subscribers dict is per-worker; if backend ever runs multiple workers, SSE will be inconsistent. Acceptable for MVP; document.

critical_code_review_comments: PinResult.jsx SSE catch block correctly logs via console.error(parseErr) — code review fix verified.
flashdrop-crypto.js AES-GCM 256 impl is correct: 12-byte IV prepended to ciphertext+tag, exported/imported via base64url; key never leaves the browser (URL fragment only).
ReceiveFlow.jsx disables the download button and shows missing-key-warning when encrypted=true but hash is absent — matches spec.
server.py _publish_ping uses put_nowait with QueueFull silently dropped — acceptable, but consider logging drops.
server.py encrypted flag is a boolean form field: Pydantic accepts it, and the flag is echoed back on both POST /api/upload and GET /api/file/{pin} (verified).
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event; recommend lifespan migration.
server.py still calls asyncio.create_task from sync _cleanup_bundle_sync (BackgroundTask context) — same fragility flag as prior iterations.
seed_data_creation: Transient bundles created and cleaned via DELETE /api/file/{pin} in pytest fixtures; ephemeral in-browser Files created via DataTransfer for UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend test file added at /app/backend/tests/test_flashdrop_e2ee_pings.py — covers encrypted flag echo and SSE /api/pings/{pin} (ready + download events, zip kind, unknown pin 404). To test SSE from Python, use requests.get(stream=True) on a background thread and give it ~1.5s to subscribe before triggering download. New frontend testids exercised: landing-page, hero-launch-btn, nav-launch-btn, cta-launch-btn, e2ee-toggle-row, e2ee-toggle-switch, e2ee-badge, e2ee-receive-badge, missing-key-warning, live-pings-panel, live-pings-status ('Listening'/'Offline'), live-pings-empty, live-ping-item. E2EE roundtrip validated with SHA-256 (plaintext in == plaintext out). Frontend upload via file input requires DataTransfer.items.add(File) + input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')) because <input> is hidden.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
